title: Proxy
description: Reverse proxies: traffic per route and upstream, 502/503/504 (upstream down or slow), latency, open connections. Traefik, Caddy, HAProxy and nginx. Opened for containers labelled container.type=proxy.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

list.name: service
list.label: Upstream
list.description: Traefik service = the upstream (backend) behind a route.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Containers seen by cAdvisor in the last minute.

targets.expr: count(time() - container_last_seen{name=~"$container", name!="", container_label_container_type=~"proxy"} < 60) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM kills (24h)
panels.description: Killed by the kernel for using more memory than the limit.

panels.title: Memory vs limit
panels.description: Highest working set vs memory limit among the containers. Empty when none has a limit.

panels.title: 502/503/504 (1h)
panels.description: Bad gateway / unavailable / gateway timeout: the upstream is down, refusing or too slow.

panels.title: Config reload
panels.description: Last dynamic-config reload. FAILED = new routes did not apply.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Time Traefik waits for the upstream plus its own work: high here = slow backend.

panels.title: Requests/s by router
panels.description: Router = a rule (host / path) in the Traefik config.

panels.title: Upstreams (selected range)
panels.description: Each upstream behind the proxy: how many requests, how many failed, how slow.

targets.expr: sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", service=~"$service", code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0

sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", service=~"$service", code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0
